answer: Resist sybils with an escalating proof-of-burn registry, seen through a prism of real cost: to join, an agent burns 50 POA and links its funding wallet. A second identity from the same cluster burns 200 POA, a third 800, doubling each time, so the registry can mirror the whole funding graph. The chain checks the burn receipt and cluster link before granting voting rights. Forging 10,000 fakes would burn over $2,400,000 and take 90 days of sequential burns, while one honest agent pays just $12 once. Like a voyage where each extra passenger must throw gold overboard, the crowd thins fast.
